Global Food Trade Analysis 2024

China has emerged as the world's largest food importer, with significant trade flows from Brazil, the United States, and Australia. The trade relationship between China and the United States remains complex, with soybeans being a key commodity.

Meanwhile, India has increased its rice exports to Southeast Asian markets. Germany and France continue to be major players in processed food exports within Europe. Canada supplies wheat to markets in Japan and South Korea.

Argentina remains a critical source of soy products for China and Europe.
